title: When the Debt Burns
author: Cyrus Marchetti
blurb: Jude Pemberton, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
